Reference Data Analyst

Position Overview

Job Title: Reference Data Analyst

Corporate Title: Associate

Location: Jaipur, India

Role Description

The Reference Data Analyst focuses on effective oversight of strategic data used across the bank's systems and infrastructure. The Reference Data Analyst supports various elements of the data lifecycle, from ensuring that data is captured from the best source, to validating and classifying, and operating controls that optimize its quality and maximize coverage. The Reference Data Analyst has responsibility for maintaining robust processes related to data set-up, storage and distribution, as well as system configuration, together with participation in projects designed to streamline infrastructure and improve efficiency. Reference data is integral to the bank's response to regulatory requirements. Close partnership is needed with stakeholders such as Front Office, Middle Office, Audit, Compliance and Regulatory. Reporting to deliver solutions that balance immediate business priorities with long term strategic objectives. An Analyst primarily handles data operations and generates reports from data interpretation. CAM analyst performs checks to authenticate the requests on the basis of the documents received, completeness and correctness. Processing the Static requests on the various downstream systems as per the process guidelines. Investigate open items/Risk items and resolve as required. Escalate unresolved open items per departmental policy.

What we'll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy,

  • Best in class leave policy.
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

Process

  • Data input & approval of Account opening, maintenance process & SSI functions in downstream system.
  • Ensuring the processing guidelines (KOP) are followed with diligence.
  • Monitoring the mailboxes in terms of processing and queries.
    Participating in employee engagement activities & effective participation in team huddle and contribution in regular meetings.
  • Ensuring the mandatory trainings are completed within the time.
    Leaves and breaks needs to plan in line with process deliverables, ensuring timely updates on HR-Workday.
  • Meet productivity target of 100% and makes sure the 2 eye processing is completed within agreed SLA & 100% accuracy.
  • Assisting the team and the process in reviewing the KOP.

Control

  • Account opening, maintenance process & SSI has to be followed as per CAM KOP.
  • Owning the issues, resolve it on priority and escalating wherever required as per escalation matrix.

Change

  • Identify possible automation opportunities and reduce manual intervention.
  • To work in the direction of finding process gaps and ideas to remediate the same.

Your skills and experience


  • Minimum Bachelor's degree or equivalent in relevant field
  • 0.6 to 6 years of work experience in corporate Banking
  • Basic knowledge of Banking operations/Financial Products (Fixed income cash & derivatives Financial Products and financial instruments including Futures, Options, Swaps).
  • Microsoft Office/Suite proficient (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
    Good communication skills. Interaction with the Middle Office and/or Clients to ensure the timely and accurate processing of all life cycle events.
  • Must be able to work well and adapt to change in a fast-paced environment
  • Ensure that all work is delivered, meet the agreed production standards, and SLA timeframes & responsible for all process related MI reports
  • Adherence to STARC standards and procedures and ensuring that there are no lapses or gaps in control.
  • Keep team management informed of status of cases and proactively identify and flag issues.
  • Creating the EOD (Log reports) for the transactions processed on a daily basis. Ensure EOD controls
  • Should be flexible in working hours, also should be able to support in different time zones on rotational basis
  • Able to work under pressure and against challenging timescales.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we'll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career.
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team.
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

About us and our teams

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

data.title: Senior Data Analyst
data.description:
Job Description:

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to drive data-driven decision-making across business functions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in analytics, data engineering, automation, and stakeholder management. This role requires hands-on experience in building scalable ETL pipelines, analytical data models, automated reporting systems, and advanced analytics solutions. Will work closely with business, product, risk, operations, and leadership teams to deliver actionable insights, optimise processes, and support strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

. Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines and automated data workflows using Python, SQL, PySpark, and MongoDB.
. Analyse large and complex datasets to generate actionable business insights and solve critical business problems.
. Build and optimise analytical data models, data marts, and reporting layers for business intelligence and decision-making.
. Develop and automate MIS reports, dashboards, and KPI frameworks using BI tools such as Power BI.
. Perform data validation, anomaly detection, and implement robust data quality checks across the data lifecycle.
. Collaborate with stakeholders across Risk, Collections, Underwriting, Marketing, and Operations teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions.
. Design and maintain data warehouse and data lake structures to support enterprise reporting and analytics.
. Drive end-to-end ownership of analytics projects from requirement gathering to deployment and monitoring.
. Optimise SQL queries and data processing workflows to improve performance and reduce execution time.
. Ensure adherence to data governance, privacy, security, and quality standards.
. Mentor junior analysts and contribute to building best practices within the analytics team.

Required Skills:

. 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python for data analysis, automation, and ETL development.
. Strong expertise in SQL with experience in query optimisation and performance tuning.
. 2+ years of hands-on experience with PySpark for large-scale data processing.
. Experience working with MongoDB and handling large datasets.
. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing, and data modelling.
. Experience with Power BI or similar BI and reporting tools.
. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
. Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills:

. Experience in financial services, lending, risk analytics, or fintech domains.
. Exposure to cloud platforms and modern data architectures.
. Knowledge of data governance, data quality frameworks, and automation best practices.

data.description:
Asa Product Data Analyst and Quality Engineer trainee, you will gain exposure to product quality engineering activities with a focus on warranty data analysis, module-level testing, failure analysis, and AI-supported customer anomaly investigation.

Through on-the-job training, you will learn to use GenAI and analytical methods to support warranty PPM and warranty cost trend analysis, identify trends and anomalies, create dashboards to illustrate key insights, and participate in improvement discussions with the project team.

You will also gain practical experience using software tools, bench test setups, laboratory equipment, module schematics, and engineering documentation to support failure analysis, while learning structured problem-solving tools such as 8D and Diagnostic Trees under guidance from technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Electronic, Electrical, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or related Engineering discipline.
  • Interest in learning and applying GenAI tools, data analysis, and dashboard visualization to support quality and warranty trend analysis.
  • Basic understanding of electronic manufacturing, assembly, test processes, or product quality concepts.
  • Basic exposure to schematic diagrams, electronic components, semiconductor devices, or laboratory test equipment is preferred.
  • Analytical mindset with willingness to learn structured problem-solving methods such as 8D, Diagnostic Trees, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

FUNCTIONS:

  • Apply GenAI tools to support analysis of warranty PPM and warranty cost trends, including identification of trends, anomalies, and incoming spikes from warranty data.
  • Develop and use AI-supported tools and dashboards to visualize warranty trends, highlight key insights, and support data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Conduct module-level testing and failure analysis on assigned product catalogs using software tools, bench test setups, laboratory equipment, module schematics, and engineering documentation.
  • Apply failure investigation methodologies and root cause analysis techniques to troubleshoot product issues and support resolution with technical stakeholders.
  • Use AI-supported approaches to strengthen customer anomaly investigation, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Apply structured problem-solving tools, including 8D and Diagnostic Trees, to real business cases and customer anomaly investigations.
  • Document investigation findings, prepare analysis reports, and present recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional project teams to identify improvement initiatives, corrective actions, and opportunities to improve quality performance.

Interpersonal:

  • Demonstrate good working relationships within work group.
  • Look for ways to collaborate and build teamwork with others.
  • Demonstrate responsiveness and promptness in serving customer needs.
  • Protect confidential information.
  • Balance many priorities and competing demands effectively.
  • Understand the business environment in which RA operates and works with global team supporting off office hours meetings as required.
  • Understand the organization's mission and strategies.

data.title: Data Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

As enterprise data becomes ever more crucial to operational efficiency and strategic direction, the Senior Data Analyst plays a central role in converting complex data assets into actionable intelligence. Working within the Data Services group, this position focuses on building scalable analytics solutions, tracking critical data quality indicators, and maintaining enterprise reporting frameworks across core master data domains-including Item, Customer, and Supplier domains.

In this role, you will interface directly with business leaders, data engineering teams, and MDM specialists to surface operational trends and establish data-driven decision frameworks. Utilizing modern analytics ecosystems-such as Databricks, cloud architectures, Informatica tools, and visualization suites like Tableau or Power BI-the position drives enhanced data governance, clearer operational visibility, and measurable business performance.

Key Responsibilities

BI Development & Dashboarding

  • Build, refine, and sustain enterprise-level scorecards and interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.

  • Translate operational metrics, key trends, and data quality indicators into clear, intuitive visual reports.

  • Establish self-service reporting capabilities to allow cross-functional teams direct access to insights.

  • Gather requirements from business partners and convert them into robust, maintainable dashboard architectures.

  • Validate reporting consistency and ensure strict alignment with organizational data standards and governance policies.

Advanced Analytics & Business Insights

  • Execute exploratory and structured data analyses to pinpoint operational bottlenecks, trends, and growth opportunities.

  • Define and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to track both operational efficiency and underlying data health.

  • Lead root-cause investigations for data discrepancies and business process breakdowns.

  • Provide data-backed recommendations and strategic analysis to support business initiatives and ad hoc executive requests.

Master Data & Quality Assurance

  • Perform deep-dive analysis across primary master data domains (Supplier, Customer, Product/Item).

  • Partner with Data Governance and MDM teams on profiling, validation, cleansing, and ongoing monitoring efforts.

  • Design and deploy data quality scorecards to monitor record completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency.

  • Work alongside Data Stewards to troubleshoot and resolve data integrity issues at the source.

Data Platform & Engineering Collaboration

  • Construct complex SQL queries and analyze large-scale datasets within Databricks and cloud-based warehouse environments.

  • Coordinate with Data Engineers to verify data pipeline outputs, data models, and underlying reporting tables.

  • Help define business logic, metrics definitions, and semantic layer architectures.

  • Perform rigorous validation testing for new analytics tools, feature releases, and database updates.

Stakeholder Management & Enablement

  • Engage cross-functional teams to understand operational needs and spot high-impact analytics opportunities.

  • Present complex analytical findings, findings, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Maintain complete documentation of metric logic, data definitions, calculation rules, and analytics workflows.

  • Conduct user enablement sessions and offer ongoing support for deployed reporting solutions.

Core Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience & Skills

Required:

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or enterprise reporting.

  • Demonstrated proficiency with BI visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

  • Strong hands-on SQL query writing and dataset analysis capabilities.

  • Practical experience working with large-scale datasets sourced from varied enterprise systems.

  • Proven ability to gather business specifications and translate them into functional technical deliverables.

  • Background in developing KPIs, tracking performance metrics, and supporting data quality processes.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to Master Data Management (MDM) frameworks and tools (e.g., Informatica MDM, Informatica IDQ).

  • Experience using cloud-based data platforms and analytics environments (Databricks, Spark, AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Familiarity with data governance practices, dimensional modeling, and data warehousing principles.

  • Experience working within Agile project frameworks.

  • Working knowledge of Python for automated data processing or exploratory analysis.

Technical & Core Competencies

  • Visualization & Analytics: Power BI, Tableau, Advanced Excel, Data Storytelling, Dashboard Architecture, Performance Metrics/KPI Design.

  • Data Engineering & Querying: SQL, Relational Databases, Databricks, Data Warehousing, Data Modeling Concepts, Data Quality Profiling.

  • Preferred Tools: Informatica IDQ (Analyst/Developer), Informatica MDM, Delta Lake, PySpark/Python, Git, Azure DevOps.

  • Core Strengths: Problem-solving, Root-Cause Analysis, Data Governance Awareness, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Statistical Interpretation.

Job Description:

Support the analysis of daily operational data to track Sorting Center throughput, helping the team balance Speed, Cost, and Quality.

Basic Data Analysis & Issue Tracking

  • Assist in tracking key SLA metrics and prepare data breakdowns to support continuous improvement projects.

Operation Support & Implementation

  • Provide data insights to support on-the-ground operational solutions for daily hub issues.
  • Support project follow-ups and track initiative progress across operational teams.

Requirements:

  • Good communication
  • 0-2 years in data analysis or reporting (fresh graduates welcome)
  • Proficient in Excel/Google Sheets experience with AI, n8n, or other data tools is a plus
  • Background on Machine/ Production is a plus
  • Multitasking and prioritizing skills.
  • Work with fast, timeline and extra long working hours during campaign
  • Mostly Afternoon/ Night Shift
  • Fast Response, under pressure

data.title: AVP/VP, Data Analyst, Operational Risk Management
data.description:
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Risk & Performance Management Department

In Risk & Performance Management Department (RPMD), we work collaboratively across teams to identify and address potential blind spots, ensuring that all relevant risks are considered and duly addressed.

Operational Risk Management

The Operational Risk Management (ORM) team is responsible for driving and managing the corporate operational risk management programme within GIC. Operational risk tools and analytics are developed to better inform management about the operational risk landscape. We are looking for a dynamic and self-motivated individual to join the team as an Assistant Vice President/ Vice President, focusing on data analytics to strengthen risk and control oversight.

What impact can you make in this role

You will be part of a team responsible for the independent assessment, measurement, monitoring and reporting of GIC's operational risk profile. You will bring a data-driven approach across the team's mandate, using analytics and AI/LLM tools to evaluate controls, support third-party and outsourcing risk assessments, generate insights, and strengthen the firm's overall risk and control environment.

What will you do as an AVP/VP in ORM

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and data analytics capability to meet the team's risk analysis, monitoring and reporting needs
  • Analyse and interpret large data sets to identify risks, control gaps, trends and thematic issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Apply data analytics to enhance control assurance and testing (e.g. automating test procedures, running full-population testing on raw transactional data in place of sampling, and identifying control exceptions and anomalies)
  • Support third-party and outsourcing due diligence and risk assessments with data-driven analysis (e.g. vendor risk data, concentration analysis, and identification of emerging risks)
  • Leverage AI/LLM tools to augment risk and control workflows (e.g. reviewing documentation, extracting and summarising key information from contracts and reports, comparing responses against policy requirements to flag gaps, and generating first-cut insights for reviewer refinement)
  • Track, collate and report key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) across the team's remit, and analyse trends to flag emerging risks and control weaknesses
  • Monitor and report risk and control outcomes to senior management and GIC's risk governance committees
  • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of methodologies, frameworks and supporting tools, including embedding AI/analytics into assessment workflows
  • Work with risk managers and business stakeholders to embed a rigorous, data-driven approach across the team's activities

What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role

Must-haves:

  • At least 5 (AVP) and 7 (VP) years experience in data analytics, business intelligence or a related field
  • Strong / advanced proficiency in data mining, analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau), and programming languages such as Python and SQL
  • Practical experience applying AI/LLM tools to analytics or risk work (e.g. document review, summarisation, gap analysis, and workflow automation)

Good to have:

  • Experience in control assurance, control testing, or a related assurance discipline, including familiarity with control frameworks and testing methodologies
  • Experience in third-party risk management, vendor due diligence or outsourcing risk, including familiarity with due diligence methodologies and risk assessment frameworks
  • Broader domain knowledge in operational risk, audit or a related risk and controls field

Attributes:

  • Intellectually curious, with a passion for using data and AI to connect the dots and generate insights that translate into value for stakeholders
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to synthesise diverse information into clear conclusions
  • Adept at presenting findings in strong, digestible visuals
  • Forward-thinking and keen to stay current with developments in the risk, analytics and AI space
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across business areas and seniority levels
  • Strong organisational and project management skills

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Please email [HIDDEN TEXT] at any point of the application or interview process if adjustments need to be made due to a disability.

Learn more about our Risk & Performance Management Department here:

https://gic.careers/group/risk-performance-management/

data.title: Data Analyst - Finance (Remote)
data.description:
• Role: Data Analyst - Finance (Remote)
  • Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Financial Data Analyst to work on a Full-Time basis. This role involves analyzing financial data to support decision-making and reporting. The position requires expertise in financial modeling, data visualization, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

• Collect, process, and analyze financial data from multiple sources to identify trends and anomalies.

• Develop and maintain financial models to forecast revenue, expenses, and cash flow.

• Prepare detailed reports and dashboards for stakeholders to support strategic planning.

• Ensure data accuracy and compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate financial insights into business operations.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Proficiency in financial data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, or Python.

• Experience with financial modeling and forecasting techniques.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting standards.

• Ability to create visualizations using tools like Tableau or Power BI.

• Familiarity with data cleaning and validation processes.

More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the financial services industry, contributing to accurate financial reporting and strategic decision-making.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

Apply Now!

data.title: Data Analyst (Demand planning and Forecast)
data.description:
A multinational semiconductor supplier seeks a Data Analyst to enhance demand forecasting accuracy by designing, implementing, and operating advanced analytical solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and refine time-series statistical models for demand forecasting accuracy over an 18-month horizon using R and Python on Google Cloud Platform
  • Automate business processes by developing machine learning models with Python
  • Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify risks, opportunities, trends, and patterns
  • Translate complex business challenges into scalable, robust, and sustainable analytical solutions using creative problem-solving and deep data expertise
  • Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations with Microsoft Power BI to communicate insights and support data-driven decisions
  • Present complex information effectively using data visualization techniques via Microsoft Power BI
  • Continuously assess and improve forecasting methods, planning processes, and analytical tools to deliver measurable business value
  • Collaborate with Supply Chain, Sales, and IT teams to drive adoption of analytical solutions and best practices

Required competencies and certifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics or Mathematics with 5 years of relevant experience
  • Minimum 2 years of Python programming experience
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in time series forecasting, including univariate, multivariate, and ensemble modeling
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with database technologies (e.g., SQL) for querying, database creation, and stored procedures
  • At least 1 year of experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent cloud services (AWS, Microsoft Azure)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience using Microsoft Power BI

Preferred competencies and qualifications

  • Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, and forecasting applications in supply chain and demand planning
  • Experience with SAP IBP or other advanced planning systems

data.title: Data Analyst | Offshore
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Description - Data Analyst Position Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst to collect, analyze, and interpret data to support business and operational decision-making. The role involves working with large datasets, developing dashboards and reports, and translating data into actionable insights.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze and interpret structured and unstructured data to identify trends, patterns, and business insights.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Write efficient SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
  • Perform data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Define and track KPIs and metrics to support business performance analysis.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Support data-driven process improvements and ad-hoc analytical requests.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis or business intelligence.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and data manipulation.
  • Experience with Excel and BI/visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
Preferred Skills
  • Experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
  • Knowledge of ETL/data pipelines and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Exposure to statistical analysis, forecasting, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.
